description.overview: We are looking for a capable Video Editor to join our Media & Photography team and contribute directly to our growth in Design / Graphics / Creative Arts.
topReasonsToJoin: Sponsored sport clubs, happy hour and wellness activities
Strong work-life balance culture, no unnecessary overtime
Competitive salary reviewed twice a year
responsibilities: Coordinate core media & photography activities aligned with company goals and standards.
Handle quality standards and process compliance, ensuring consistency and accuracy across all deliverables.
Coordinate documentation and knowledge sharing and provide regular updates to relevant stakeholders.
Process continuous improvement initiatives to support smooth execution and timely delivery.
Coordinate reporting and performance tracking, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and quality.
Handle stakeholder communication and updates in partnership with other departments and external partners.
requirements: At least 1-3 years of hands-on experience relevant to the Video Editor role.
Solid understanding of industry best practices and relevant tools or systems.
Good command of English (written and spoken)
Ability to work independently and under pressure
Good stakeholder management and cross-team collaboration
Eagerness to learn and grow within a professional environment.

benefits.label: Opportunity to work with international partners
Clear career development and promotion path
Team building activities and company trips
13th month salary and performance bonus
16-18 days of paid annual leave
Recognition programs and quarterly awards
